entities.summary: Abd Al-Karim Qasim Mohammed Bakr Al-Qaraghuli Al-Zubaidi  was an Iraqi military officer and statesman who served as the Prime Minister and de facto leader of Iraq from 1958 until his overthrow in 1963.
